integrity: Original claim isolated from known cubic-modulus Franel supercongruence; all cited previously known lemmas and the Wolstenholme-prime equivalence are credited. No publication or independent certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Uniform leading coefficient only; no exact higher valuation at Wolstenholme primes; prime-power indices and primes at least five. External independent review not performed. Potential implicit coverage by stronger general p-adic theorems remains a priority risk.
title: The Bernoulli leading digit of the Franel prime-power supercongruence
